title: An in vitro method to survey DNA methylation in peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) treated by airborne particulate matter (PM10)
author: Faraji, Pourpak, et al.
materials: Genomic DNA was extracted from each sample using the QIAamp DNA blood mini kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) according to the manufacturer’s instruction. DNA concentration was measured based on absorbance at 260 nm using Nanodrop spectrophotometer (NanoDrop Technologies, Wilmington, DE, USA).

steps.title: Prepare PM10 suspension
steps.instruction: Extract PM10 particles from filters, autoclave, and suspend in RPMI‑1640 at the required concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Cut the collected filters into small pieces and place the pieces into 50 mL centrifuge tubes.
Place the tubes in an ultrasonic bath (Elma‑ultrasonic, Germany) for 45 min, then sweep the tube walls gently with a brush.
Collect the released PM10 particles into endotoxin‑free vials, weigh them, and store at –18 °C until use.
Immediately before each experiment, autoclave the dried particles and resuspend them in RPMI‑1640 culture medium to obtain the desired test concentrations (e.g., 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300 µg/mL).

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs from blood
steps.instruction: Obtain peripheral blood, perform Ficoll density gradient centrifugation, and prepare a viable PBMC suspension.

substeps.instruction: Draw 20 mL of whole blood from each of five male donors (16–18 years old) into anticoagulant‑treated tubes.
In a laminar‑flow hood, dilute each blood sample with 40 mL Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS (Biosera, France) and mix gently.
Add 30 mL Ficoll‑Hypaque solution (Biosera, France) to the diluted blood and centrifuge for 22 min at 2000 rpm (no acceleration, no brake).
Collect the PBMC layer, wash sequentially with lysis buffer and isolation buffer, then centrifuge at 400 g for 14 min (acceleration 6, brake 4).
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL complete RPMI‑1640 medium (Gibco BRL, San Diego, CA), count cells using trypan blue exclusion, and confirm viability >95 %.
Keep the PBMC suspension in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5 % (v/v) CO₂.

steps.title: Culture and treat PBMCs
steps.instruction: Seed PBMCs, allow attachment, then expose them to PM10 suspensions at defined concentrations.

substeps.instruction: Seed PBMCs at a density of 5 × 10⁵ cells/mL in RPMI‑1640 medium and incubate for 24 h at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Treat the cells for 4 h with PM10 suspensions at six concentrations: 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, and 300 µg/mL. Perform each concentration in triplicate and include untreated cells as negative controls.
After the 4‑h exposure, collect the culture medium and centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 8 min to pellet the cells.
Store the cell pellets at –20 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate DNA from the stored cell pellets using a commercial kit and quantify it.

substeps.instruction: Extract genomic DNA from each pellet with the QIAamp DNA Blood Mini Kit (Qiagen, Hilden, Germany) following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Measure DNA concentration by absorbance at 260 nm using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer (NanoDrop Technologies, Wilmington, DE, USA).

steps.title: Quantify DNA methylation
steps.instruction: Determine global 5‑mC and 5‑hmC levels in the extracted DNA by ELISA.

substeps.instruction: Use the 5‑mC ELISA kit and the Quest 5‑hmC™ DNA ELISA kit (both Zymo Research, Orange, CA, USA).
For each sample, assay 100 ng of extracted genomic DNA according to the manufacturers’ protocols; run each sample in duplicate.
Note detection limits per 100 ng single‑stranded DNA: 0.5 % for 5‑mC and 0.02 % for 5‑hmC.

steps.title: Statistical data analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the effect of PM10 concentration on DNA methylation changes using R.

substeps.instruction: Treat PM10 concentrations (50–300 µg/mL) as the independent variable; the differences in %5‑mC and %5‑hmC relative to controls are the response variables.
Perform analyses in R version 3.4.3; significance threshold p < 0.05.
For %5‑mC: Shapiro–Wilk test p = 0.01 → use non‑parametric Scheirer‑Ray‑Hare test (FSA package) and report median ± IQR; post‑hoc Dunn test for pairwise comparisons.
For %5‑hmC: Shapiro–Wilk p = 0.11 and Bartlett p = 0.89 → apply ANOVA; post‑hoc TukeyHSD for multiple comparisons.
